Bundled library theories
========================
isabelle/afp_smooth_library/Analysis_More.thy
isabelle/afp_smooth_library/Smooth.thy

These theories originate from Smooth Manifolds, by Fabian Immler and Bohua
Zhan, Archive of Formal Proofs (2018). The AFP entry identifies the BSD license.
The license is retained in AFP-LICENSE.txt. The checked copies are pinned by
SHA256SUMS; LCTR's session/check theory and import layout are provided alongside.

Entry: https://isa-afp.org/entries/Smooth_Manifolds.html
License: https://isa-afp.org/LICENSE

Lean, Isabelle, Mathlib and the independent checker implementations are external
dependencies. Their sources and binaries are obtained separately at the pinned
versions. They are not relicensed by this supplement.
